parse_note: Use authoritative positive Available device rows, never the repeated per-SLR zero rows. Do not add disjoint OOC results to infer full-DUT size because DSP allocation and cross-hierarchy optimization differ.

priority_proof.composition: The existing 40-input-bit index SAT proves each full-sequence slot predicate matches the cyclic offset. This proof universally compares first failure in that cyclic order with two priority encoders for every 256-bit failure pattern and all 8-bit lows. Full generated-module comparisons remain separately bound.

reduction_proof.argument: All partial sums bounded by 256*(2^64-1)<2^72; +& is exact at each balanced node; original 73-bit reduction never wraps.

proof.permutation_argument: For each watermark, offsets 1..256 bijectively cover physical slots; first failing offset equals minimum failing slot distance, or 257 when all pass, minus 1
